summary.tldr: Limits the foreign affairs minister from making trade commitments that would weaken tariff protections for dairy, poultry or eggs.
what_it_does: Prohibits the Minister of Foreign Affairs from agreeing, in an international trade treaty or agreement, to raise tariff rate quotas for dairy products, poultry or eggs.
Prohibits the Minister of Foreign Affairs from agreeing to lower the tariff on dairy products, poultry or eggs imported above their tariff rate quotas.
who_it_affects: Importers of dairy, poultry and eggs
summary.background: The bill adds a new rule to section 10 of the Department of Foreign Affairs, Trade and Development Act.
